answer: The fable graph is validated at intake and the ocean frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and spiral anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. An attacker who wants 7 percent of the vote must hold 15 percent of the bonded float for 84 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
